bound.how: pda ingest --source subseasonal --limit 10. The official MET Subseasonal swagger prints 6 untemplated GET paths that have a last-segment id. The adapter copies those paths. GET uses the printed /locations collection with no invented query filters. /complete prints required lat/lon so it stays unused for fetch.

search.title: List available locations as GeoJSON FeatureCollection

methods.why: Subseasonal /locations prints GeoJSON feature names (MEPS area). Those are not a numeric time series with a year-like period field. methods/ was not edited.
